legend: One day Vasya came up to the blackboard and wrote out n distinct integers from 1 to n in some order in a circle. Then he drew arcs to join the pairs of integers (a, b) (a ≠ b), that are either each other's immediate neighbors in the circle, or there is number c, such that a and с are immediate neighbors, and b and c are immediate neighbors. As you can easily deduce, in the end Vasya drew 2·n arcs.

For example, if the numbers are written in the circle in the order 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 (in the clockwise direction), then the arcs will join pairs of integers (1, 2), (2, 3), (3, 4), (4, 5), (5, 1), (1, 3), (2, 4), (3, 5), (4, 1) and (5, 2).

Much time has passed ever since, the numbers we wiped off the blackboard long ago, but recently Vasya has found a piece of paper with 2·n written pairs of integers that were joined with the arcs on the board. Vasya asks you to find the order of numbers in the circle by these pairs.
input: The first line of the input contains a single integer n (5 ≤ n ≤ 105) that shows, how many numbers were written on the board. Next 2·n lines contain pairs of integers ai, bi (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ n, ai ≠ bi) — the numbers that were connected by the arcs.
It is guaranteed that no pair of integers, connected by a arc, occurs in the input more than once. The pairs of numbers and the numbers in the pairs are given in the arbitrary order.
output: If Vasya made a mistake somewhere and there isn't any way to place numbers from 1 to n on the circle according to the statement, then print a single number "-1" (without the quotes). Otherwise, print any suitable sequence of n distinct integers from 1 to n.

If there are multiple solutions, you are allowed to print any of them. Specifically, it doesn't matter which number you write first to describe the sequence of the order. It also doesn't matter whether you write out the numbers in the clockwise or counter-clockwise direction.

legend.ai: 一天，Vasya 来到黑板前，将 1 到 n 中的 n 个互不相同的整数按某种顺序写在一个圆上。然后，他为满足以下条件之一的整数对 (a, b)（a ≠ b）连接圆弧：a 和 b 互为圆上的直接邻居，或者存在一个数 c，使得 a 和 c 是直接邻居，且 b 和 c 是直接邻居。容易推出，最终 Vasya 画出了 2·n 条圆弧。
从那以后已经过去了很长时间，我们很久以前就把黑板上的数字擦掉了，但最近 Vasya 找到了一张纸，上面写着 2·n 对曾经在黑板上由弧线连接的整数。Vasya 请你根据这些整数对找出数字在圆周上的排列顺序。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n（5 ≤ n ≤ 10^5），表示黑板上写有多少个数字。接下来的 2·n 行包含整数对 ai、bi（1 ≤ ai，bi ≤ n，ai ≠ bi），表示由弧线连接的数字。
保证任意一对由弧线连接的整数在输入中出现次数不超过一次。整数对以及整数对中的数字均以任意顺序给出。

output.ai: 如果 Vasya 在某处犯了错误，导致不存在一种按照题意将 1 到 n 的数字放置在圆周上的方法，则输出一个整数“-1”（不含引号）。否则，输出 1 到 n 中任意一个由 n 个互不相同的整数构成的合法序列。
如果存在多个解，你可以输出其中任意一个。具体来说，用哪个数字作为描述排列顺序的第一个数字并不重要。同样，以顺时针还是逆时针方向输出这些数字也不重要。
